newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: WOLTERS KLUWER BUYS U.S. BLESSING/WHITE.
newsitem.headline: WOLTERS KLUWER BUYS U.S. BLESSING/WHITE.

text.p: Dutch publisher Wolters Kluwer NV said on Thursday it had agreed to buy Blessing/White Inc in the U.S.
"Blessing/White ... is a leading provider of individual and organisational performance and development training in the United States and the United Kingdom," the Dutch group said in a statement.
No financial details of the transaction were disclosed.
Blessing/White has annual sales of about $20 million, or 34 million guilders, and employs 85 people. Its clients are major corporations.
Wolters Kluwer said the acquisition was in line with its strategy to further expand its professional training activities.
After the takeover of Blessing/White, Wolters Kluwer Professional Training will have annual turnover of about 200 million guilders. The division is active in 15 countries, it added.
